positive_snippets:
It was a wonderful experience while staying there I had room no 306 something I guess it had a balcony view wasn't very beautiful and I can't blame it on them because its right in front of a metro station if you just want to explore its perfect pick
The cons is the bathroom was small in my opinion i don't like seat very close to walls in right and left and cloth hanger in washroom was broken honestly if I had to stay there more than 1 day i must had asked them to replace it and in my opinion they would had done it for me
At the end it was a wonderful experience bed was too comfy I liked it had a table where I can eat + couch to chill on loved it just rake and bathroom was the issue I stayed there alone it was wonderful experience and yeah the area is too quiet at night so if it had just a little comfy music in reception or halls it would be the best experience
